conditions: Signed-in customer on a product detail page
items.expected: The add-to-favourites control changes to show the item is saved (e.g. filled/active state); the product appears in the favourites list when the customer navigates to it

conditions: Signed-in customer on the favourites list
Customer removes a product from favourites
items.expected: The remove action is confirmed (e.g. button changes or item collapses); the product no longer appears in the favourites list

conditions: Visitor navigates to the favourites page
items.expected: The visitor is redirected to the sign-in page; the favourites list content is not shown

conditions: Visitor not signed in attempts to access the favourites page directly via URL
items.expected: The visitor is redirected to the sign-in page and cannot see any favourites data

conditions: Favourites page loaded for a signed-in customer
axe-core scan scoped to the favourites page content
items.expected: No WCAG A/AA violations reported by axe-core
